localEquivalence.result: the provider exists but has no transcription path; the wire matches the generic multipart default, but registering mistral with format "openai" would forward unsupported fields, enable a translation route the source lacks and lose deadline/accepted-job handling, so this module is the delta

exports.mistralSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createMistralSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxTranscriptBytes } for tests
exports.buildMistralTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body: FormData } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.mistralUploadFileName: (file) -> multipart file name (source getUploadedFileName: .opus as .ogg, audio.wav when unnamed)
exports.mistralSttRefusal: (status, { secrets, retryAfter }) refusal mapping that never quotes the upstream
exports.MISTRAL_STT_CONFIG: staged sttConfig for the existing mistral registry entry

models.passthrough: refused: transcription takes only the listed ids
models.dynamicDiscovery: none: the source lists Mistral transcription models statically; the registry's validateUrl (https://api.mistral.ai/v1/models) validates keys and is not an STT model contract

transcription.body: multipart: model, language?, response_format? (json), temperature?, timestamp_granularities[]? (segment|word, repeated), file (name per mistralUploadFileName, part type from the upload or application/octet-stream)
transcription.answer: JSON object with string text (usage kept; usage.prompt_audio_seconds or duration as audio seconds)
